instruction: Examine each receipt file on the desktop and enter the transactions into the bookkeeping spreadsheet with proper categorization in the Category column.

metadata.explanation: Task requires categorizing 5 receipt transactions in column B. Expected categories with frequencies: Groceries (1x from receipt_0), Transfer (1x from receipt_1), Food (2x from receipt_2 and receipt_4), Bike Repair (1x from receipt_3). Evaluator verifies that all 5 categories appear with correct minimum frequencies in column B rows 3-20.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all 5 required transactions through expected_counts mechanism: Groceries (1), Transfer (1), Food (2), Bike Repair (1) = 5 total entries
Metric logic is semantically correct: Uses frequency counting with partial credit scoring, will only return 1.0 if all minimum counts are met
Getter logic is correct: Extracts values from column B (Category column) in the appropriate row range (3-20)
Postconfig is appropriate: Activates window and saves file (Ctrl+S) to ensure fresh state before evaluation
Expected values match task requirements: The 4 categories with their frequencies directly correspond to the 5 receipt files mentioned in the instruction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Cannot distinguish new vs pre-existing data. If the spreadsheet already contains these exact categories in rows 3-20, evaluator would pass without new work. Could be mitigated by narrowing the row range or tracking initial state.
Enhancement option: Could verify other transaction data columns (Amount, Date, Description) to ensure complete entries, not just categories
Edge case handling: If more robust verification is needed, could check that the categories appear in consecutive rows starting from a known position rather than scattered across the range
